# Working Agreement

- Keep the dashboard focused on the FastForward Logistics operations review use case.
- Prefer existing Vue and CSS patterns in this repository before adding abstractions.
- Keep representative data local until a backend contract exists.
- Preserve the information hierarchy: KPIs, trend and regional comparison, then actionable exceptions.
- Run `npm run build` after changes to Vue templates, styles, or dependencies.
- Update `BRIEF.md` or `context/product-notes.md` when scope or product decisions change.
